project.name: Mood Studio V2
project.description: Hệ thống quản lý Studio áo cưới chuyên nghiệp - Version 2 redesign

tech_stack.api_pattern: Server Actions with withAuth() higher-order logic for atomic mutations

database_schema.summary: Core: contracts, contract_items, customers, leads. Support: printing_orders, inventory_reservations, inventory_items, contract_notes (NEW), transaction_categories, studio_info, labs.

design_system.description: Earth-tone luxury palette — Stripe-inspired, Apple HIG compliant

components.UnifiedModal: Standard modal wrapper for all CRUD forms
components.StatusSelect: Interactive status dropdown with color-coded logic

decisions.decision: All mutations MUST go through Server Actions (withAuth). No direct client-side Supabase writes in V2 detail components.
decisions.reason: Security, atomic transactions, and better SSR/Server Component alignment.

decisions.decision: Use revalidateContractCaches(contractId) as the standard invalidation pattern after mutations.
decisions.reason: Ensures all SWR tags (detail, items, payments, etc.) are refreshed consistently.

decisions.decision: Inventory Return logic: Marking a reservation as 'returned' automatically updates its inventory_item to 'available'.
decisions.reason: V2 automated inventory management — reduces manual status updates.
